Draft RFC 1 denotational companion: Day is an indexed process bicategory—or candidate equipment—fibred over frames; teloi are frame-dependent predicates, atoms are process 1-cells, bridges are composites, and realizability is witnessed by 2-cells from the present predicate to the predicate induced by a bridge and target telos.
